$description: Company-level inputs for Stage 5 collateral. Identity values (colour, type, marks) are NOT here; they come from brand/design-tokens.json and brand/logos and are locked.
positioningLine: We do the math. If what you have is right, we say so.
bannerSloganNote: Client request, Breanna Ellis, 2026-09-21. Used on the social banners only; the site's proposition (positioningLine, the homepage H1) is unchanged. Flagged for compliance review: the brand voice bans superlatives and promised outcomes, and 'Peak Protection' reads as a claim about the level of cover while 'Every Policy' reads as a claim about all of them. See COLLATERAL-COMPLIANCE.md.
mediaBaseUrlNote: Absolute https base for the single hosted email-signature logo. The site repo must serve web/email/ assets from this path (public/brand/). Unconfirmed until the domain is confirmed.
independentAgencyLine: Desert Peak Insurance is an independent agency, not an insurer. No coverage is bound by email.
independentAgencyLineWeb: Desert Peak Insurance is an independent agency, not an insurer. No coverage is bound by this website.
licensedLine: Licensed in AZ, ID, NV, UT

tpmo.citation: 42 CFR § 422.2267(e)(41), as amended 90 FR 15911 (Apr. 15, 2025); verified at law.cornell.edu 2026-09-13
tpmo.text: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent {{TODO:compliance.tpmo.orgCount}} organizations which offer {{TODO:compliance.tpmo.planCount}} products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
tpmo.note: Plan-year counts are client data (site TODO-CLIENT-DATA #11). Until supplied, every Medicare asset renders the TODO tokens visibly; that is intended.

social.handlesNote: Social handles are client data (site TODO-CLIENT-DATA #7); none are printed on any asset until supplied.

fallbackFonts.note: Email cannot load web fonts; Helvetica Neue/Arial is the grotesque closest to Archivo on Mac/Windows. Decks ship the OFL font files alongside; Arial/Georgia are the fallbacks when they are not installed (DECISIONS.md).
